munit:config.name: customers-api-test-suite.xml
munit:config.doc:name: MUnit Config
munit:config.doc:description: MUnit test configuration for the Customer Service API implementation flows

munit:test.name: get-customers-success-test
munit:test.description: Verifies that GET /customers flow returns a non-empty JSON array of Customer objects

munit-tools:assert-that.message: Customer list should contain at least one customer
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert customer list not empty

munit-tools:assert-that.message: First customer should have an id field
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert customer has id

munit-tools:assert-that.message: First customer should have a name field
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert customer has name

munit-tools:assert-that.message: First customer should have an email field
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert customer has email

munit:test.name: post-customers-success-test
munit:test.description: Verifies that POST /customers flow creates a new customer and returns 201

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { name: "Test Customer", email: "<EMAIL_ADDRESS_6>", phone: "555-000-1234" }

munit:test.munit:validation: <munit-tools:assert-that expression="#[payload.email]" is="#[MunitTools::equalTo('')]" message="Created customer email should match request" doc:name="Assert customer email matches" />

munit:test.name: get-customer-by-id-success-test
munit:test.description: Verifies that GET /customers/{customerId} flow returns the customer matching the provided ID

munit-tools:assert-that.message: Response payload should not be null
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert payload not null

munit-tools:assert-that.message: Customer name should not be null
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert customer name not null

munit-tools:assert-that.message: Customer email should not be null
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert customer email not null

munit:test.name: post-customers-missing-name-test
munit:test.description: Verifies POST /customers handles a request with missing required name field

flow-ref.name: post:\customers:application\json:api-config
flow-ref.doc:name: Call POST /customers flow with missing name

munit-tools:assert-that.message: Response payload should not be null
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert payload not null

munit-tools:assert-that.message: Response should still have a generated id
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert id is generated

munit-tools:assert-that.message: Name should be null when not provided
munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Assert name is null
